content.title: What Is the Course Record at Augusta National for the Masters?
content.text: Apr 11, 2024, 8:23 AM min read (AP Photo/Bill Haber) The course record at Augusta National at the Masters is 63 (9-under), which has been done twice. Nick Price shot a 63 in the third round of the 1986 Masters, and then Greg Norman matched it in the opening round in 1996.
